mapper.select: SELECT id, scene_code, channel, template_name, description, subject, body_content, require_fields, provider_template_code, im_message_type, channel_defaults_json, priority, status, created_at, updated_at, updated_by, created_by, version, remark FROM message_template WHERE scene_code = #{sceneCode} AND channel = #{channel} AND status = 1 AND priority = (SELECT MAX(priority) FROM message_template WHERE scene_code = #{sceneCode} AND channel = #{channel} AND status = 1) LIMIT 1
